newsitem.title: USA: Switzerland's TAG Heuer seeks NYSE listing in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Switzerland's TAG Heuer seeks NYSE listing in IPO.

text.p: Swiss watch maker TAG Heuer SA said on Thursday it has applied to list its shares on the Swiss Exchange and American Depository Shares (ADS) on the New York Stock Exchange in its initial public offering.
The company expects the issue will hold an initial public offering to price between 215 Swiss francs and 245 Swiss francs, valuing the company at 1.2 billion to 1.3 billion Swiss francs, it said.
The company expects that the American Depository Shares will be offered at a rate of 10 ADSs per ordinary share at a price of US$17.80 to US$20.30, TAG Heuer said.
The IPO will comprise 1.32 million ordinary shares offered by the company and about 520,000 shares will be sold by certain shareholders, the company said.
Salomon Brothers Inc and SBC Warburg have been appointed joint global coordinators of the offering, TAG Heuer said.
Selling shareholders have granted U.S. underwriters an over-allotment option equal to 15 percent of the total offering, the company said.
TAG Heuer said it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer the shares.
